name: GET /api/leadflow/channels/email/health - can this tenant send, and is every sender identity complete?
description:
The RevOps deliverability panel. SPF, DKIM and DMARC ARE REPORTED SEPARATELY (5faf3fdf-7777-49fc-9c19-267f74ca3f23#AC1) rather than as one verified flag, because they fail for different reasons and are fixed by different DNS records - a single boolean tells an operator to "fix DNS", which is not an instruction anybody can follow. can_send is the conjunction of all three, computed here so no caller has to remember that partial verification is not verification.

EVERY COMMERCIAL EMAIL CARRIES IDENTITY, ADDRESS AND A WORKING OPT-OUT (5faf3fdf-7777-49fc-9c19-267f74ca3f23#AC4). from_name, from_address, business_name and physical_address are NOT NULL on leadflow_email_domain, because a commercial message without them is unlawful in most of the jurisdictions this product operates in and a nullable column makes that state storable. The opt-out is appended at render time from sdk-deliverability optout-tokens rather than pasted into copy, so it cannot be edited out of a template.

AN EMPTY DOMAIN LIST MEANS THE CHANNEL CANNOT SEND, and channel_ready says so plainly rather than leaving the caller to infer it from a zero. VERIFIED LIVE: a tenant with no configured domain returned domain_count 0 and channel_ready false.

REPUTATION DEGRADES SEPARATELY. sdk-deliverability being unreachable empties that panel and leaves the domain verdicts intact, because the verification state is local and does not depend on the reputation feed.

QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: The panel reports each DNS check separately and whether the channel can send
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
